capture_method: Interactive exact-state navigation in the official Dacia Polska configurator; hidden accordion DOM read without selecting options.
normalization_boundaries: Every equipment and technical row remains attached to the exact configuration URL from which it was observed.
Shared model-qualified technical strings are preserved literally and are not interpreted as configuration-specific scalar values.
No accessory, price, financing or optional-equipment row is included.
Capture does not itself authorize canonical master-data import.
